Good to know · Welcome page · Standard

section.p: The W on the Welcome page, the name and logo on the left screen and the logo everywhere else is a stand-in. Reception uploads the real WestBrook logo once and it replaces every one. Room types work the same way as photos: add as many as the hotel has, each with a name, a price and a picture. Here the hotel has four, so an Executive room joins the loop after Deluxe. A room type with no picture is left out.
Two cards sit on top of the photos and stay put: name and greeting on the left, the time on the right. Nothing sits on the middle screen, so the photo and its price get the room.

figcaption.b: Step 1 · The loop starts on the Welcome pageRecommended
figcaption.span: The big WestBrook name and Welcome come first. The name and greeting step aside on the left screen, because the page already carries the name. Then Standard and Deluxe, with the time card on the right.

section.p: It stays in the same spot and flips to the next city every 6 seconds, then returns to the local city. A gold dot means daytime there, grey means night.

The review page is one slide in the loop, with no photo. Each time the wall changes, it shows the next review, so three reviews flip one after another. With one review, it stays. With none, the page is skipped. The reviews here are samples, first name only, with the guest's permission.

div.p: “The staff remembered our names from the first evening.”

figcaption.span: The same page at three moments, 8 seconds apart. Shown here on the left screen, so the name and greeting sit on top. In the loop it can land on any of the three screens.

section.p: Each photo or video gets one tag when it is added. The tag decides the caption: rooms show a price, the other places show their name, and the restaurant adds its breakfast hours. A tag with no photo is left out of the loop, and so is the review page when there are no reviews.
Gym and Bar have no photo yet. The loop just moves on.
Every 8 seconds all three screens change together with a soft cross-fade. Each takes the slide its right-hand neighbour was showing, and a new one enters on the right.

figcaption.span: Same layout. The time card has moved on to London.

div.p: “The best welcome we have had at any hotel in the city.”

figcaption.b: Lobby, Reviews page, Good to know, with Gym and Bar not uploaded
figcaption.span: Nothing is shown for Gym or Bar, and the loop moves straight on, so nobody sees a gap. After Good to know the loop returns to the Welcome page.

section.p: Every slide in the loop lasts 8 seconds, so the three screens change together. A video in the loop is trimmed to the best 8 seconds for the same reason. A message is not part of the loop, so its video can run longer.

div.span: Message with a photo or none

div.div: as long as the video, up to 15 s

section.p: A welcome back, birthday or anniversary message shows on all three screens for 12 seconds, or as long as its video if it has one, up to 15 seconds. It has a picture if there is one and is plain if not. Then the loop restarts from the first slide, so nobody misses it.

div.div: Message on all three · 12 to 15 s
